messages:
harper (pm): Heads-up: EdgeBank requested a geo+tier gated multi-arm rollout for the new pricing guidance UI. Requirements: tenant-only admin toggle, regional canaries (EU/NA), a holdback baseline cohort, A/B split with two variants (aggressive vs conservative), per-tenant token budget, and an automated quiet fallback to conservative variantB. They also require Azure Blob audit exports, named on-call for 72h, and a customer-facing limited-feature badge for early ramp.

nico (eng): Suggest feature flag `feature.pricing.multiarm` modes: control / variant_a / variant_b / shadow. For EdgeBank: start shadow -> 1% visible with variant_a and variant_b split 50/50 -> step up if stable. Implement variant_b as the cheap fallback (quant + reduced context). Also add a 5% holdback cohort excluded from experiments.

ryan (sre): Canary plan: 2h window with 10m buckets. Key metrics: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, token_burn_per_min, conversion delta. Circuit-breaker triggers: error_rate >= 0.4% OR p95 > 1300ms OR token_burn > budget * 1.2 for 2 consecutive buckets -> auto-toggle affected tenants to variant_b. Also auto-notify customer ops and our on-call.

dina (sales): EdgeBank legal wants explicit rollback SLAs, named on-call, and a visible "limited" badge during the first 24h. They'll provide the Azure storage path and KMS key. I'll coordinate sign-off.

nico (eng): Draft flag YAML (implements per-tenant override and holdback):
```yaml
flag: feature.pricing.multiarm
default: control
modes:
  - control
  - variant_a
  - variant_b
  - shadow
overrides:
  - tenant: "edgebank"
    start_mode: shadow
rollout:
  - pct: 1
    split: {variant_a: 0.5, variant_b: 0.5}
fallback: variant_b
holdback_pct: 5
audit_export: azure://edgebank-exports/pricing/flags/
```

ryan (sre): Telemetry notes: tag traces `canary=multiarm_pricing`, emit per-tenant hourly exports to Azure with `flag_state` and `model_variant`. Golden prompts every 15m vs control to detect quality drift. Alerts to `#ops-edgebank` and a webhook to customer ops on auto-fallback. Add internal shadow pipeline to capture full responses without billing.

harper (pm): Acceptance gates after initial 2h canary: conversion uplift >= +1.2% OR no regression beyond -0.6%, p95 latency delta <= +150ms, token_burn delta <= +10%, and holdback cohort metrics stable. If any gate fails -> auto-toggle to variant_b + trigger postmortem. Manual abort allowed for visible customer errors.

dina (sales): I'll collect Azure container and KMS details and schedule pre-launch review with EdgeBank for 2026-10-05. They also want a comms template for customers if we flip fallback.

deploy-bot: pipeline queued: `multiarm-pricing/canary` -> smoke tests -> golden-eval -> scheduled prod canary 2026-10-08 09:00 UTC

harper (pm): Owners & timelines: Nico (eng) feature PRs by 2026-10-01; Ryan (sre) runbook, circuit-breaker, and alerts by 2026-10-03; Dina (sales) legal & customer comms by 2026-09-30. React with :white_check_mark: when PRs/links are posted.

nico (eng): Will open PRs today for flag + routing + variant_b runtime.

ryan (sre): Will draft the runbook and golden-run harness and link here when ready.

harper (pm): Thanks team  close when PRs linked and legal confirmed.
